description: This file contains transformation logic to convert request and response formats between OpenAI's embeddings API and Azure AI Cohere's API. It defines a class 'AzureAICohereConfig' with methods to map models, transform requests for image embeddings, handle general embedding requests, and process responses, including extracting usage info and mapping model names.

classes.name: AzureAICohereConfig
classes.description: Configuration class providing methods for transforming embedding request and response data between different API formats, including model mapping, image embedding request creation, and response processing.

methods.name: str _map_azure_model_group(self, model: str)
methods.description: Maps internal model identifiers to Azure AI Cohere model group names.

methods.name: ImageEmbeddingRequest _transform_request_image_embeddings( self, input: List[str], optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms a list of base64-encoded image strings into an ImageEmbeddingRequest object.

methods.name: Tuple[ImageEmbeddingRequest,EmbeddingCreateParams,List[int]] _transform_request( self, input: List[str], optional_params: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Prepares embedding requests by segregating base64 images and non-image inputs, returning appropriate request objects and image embedding indices.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response(self, response: EmbeddingResponse)
methods.description: Processes the embedding response, extracts usage info, and maps the model to Azure's naming convention.
